bugs.title: Metrics browser check asserts a stale seeded hazard description
bugs.evidence: saferoute-metrics-and-hazards-visible failed on rerun because it expects 'Loose paving near the east walkway needs attention.'. Current UI/API GET /api/safety/dashboard both return 200 and show the seeded Engineering Hall report with severity Medium, location Engineering Hall, and description 'Path lighting is dim between the east doors and service road.'. The required baseline Engineering Hall report is present; the exact check expectation does not match current seed data.

action_items: Update saferoute-metrics-and-hazards-visible to assert the seeded Engineering Hall lighting row by stable fields (location/category/severity or returned baseline description), rather than the stale 'Loose paving...' text.
